meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: Claude 会持续盯住一个 Pull Request,反复查看评论、审查线程和 CI 检查结果,修复代码里的实际问题,直到所有问题解决、检查通过、审查结论可接受才停止,最后给出带证据的总结。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude babysit、monitor 或持续检查某个 PR 的评论、审查和 CI,直到所有问题解决时触发。

say.text: 帮我 babysit 这个 PR,直到 CI 全部通过。
say.note: Claude 开始轮询检查并处理评论。

say.text: 持续盯住 PR #42,有未解决的 review 线程就处理掉。
say.note: 会查看线程并修复问题。

say.text: 监控这个 PR,评论和 CI 都清了再告诉我。
say.note: 最终给出检查结果报告。

howto.what_en: Claude keeps watching a pull request, repeatedly checking comments, review threads, and CI results, fixing real issues, and stops only when all actionable items are resolved, checks pass, and the review decision is acceptable—then reports concrete evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to babysit, monitor, or keep checking a PR's comments, reviews, and CI until all issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit this PR until CI passes.
say_en.note: Claude starts polling and addressing comments.

say_en.text: Keep an eye on PR #42 and handle unresolved review threads.
Monitor this PR and tell me when comments and CI are clean.
